# cart

## cart.R1: Add an item

The cart MUST add the quantity to the quantity that the item already has.

### Scenario: Add the same item two times

- WHEN a shopper adds 2 of "pen" and then 3 of "pen"
- THEN the cart has 5 of "pen"
